summary: `tools/model_drift.py` compares each host's pinned model classes with the host's own model catalog, read from the output of `codex debug models --bundled`, the Anthropic Models API list or the Claude models overview page, and reports a pinned ID the host no longer lists, a newer model of a pinned family and changed effort support, per class with its tiers and roles. `--issue-body` renders the upstream issue: the catalog bump diff, the frozen-task A/B that compares the pinned and the candidate model on quality and speed, and the owner's approval and release steps. A Codex capture needs `--cli-version`: the report records the CLI that printed the bundled catalog and refuses one older than the release the pinned sources name, and the maintainer protocol never uses the signed-in `codex debug models`, which prints the cached or bundled catalog and exits 0 when it cannot refresh. A run that omits a registered host exits 3 unless `--subset` is passed, and names the unchecked hosts on stderr and in the issue body. It reads local files only. The maintainer protocol describes the model catalog bump from drift report to release.
